metadata.name: Global Cyber Resilience Framework (GCRF) v1.0
metadata.description: A comprehensive cyber resilience framework specifying baseline controls for protecting information assets across governance, technical and operational domains. Synthetic framework created for pipeline testing -- not an official standard.
metadata.framework_purpose: Establish a unified baseline of cyber resilience controls.
metadata.framework_scope: All information systems, personnel and third parties handling organizational information.

controls.title: Establish an information security governance framework
controls.description: The organization shall define and maintain a documented information security governance framework approved by executive leadership.
controls.full_text: The organization shall define and maintain a documented information security governance framework approved by executive leadership.

controls.title: Define security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Security roles, responsibilities and authorities shall be defined, documented and communicated across the organization.
controls.full_text: Security roles, responsibilities and authorities shall be defined, documented and communicated across the organization.

controls.title: Maintain an information security policy suite
controls.description: A comprehensive set of information security policies shall be established, approved, published and periodically reviewed.
controls.full_text: A comprehensive set of information security policies shall be established, approved, published and periodically reviewed.

controls.title: Ensure management commitment and oversight
controls.description: Executive management shall demonstrate commitment to security through resource allocation and periodic oversight reviews.
controls.full_text: Executive management shall demonstrate commitment to security through resource allocation and periodic oversight reviews.

controls.title: Segregate conflicting duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of assets.
controls.full_text: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of assets.

controls.title: Establish a cyber risk management methodology
controls.description: A documented risk management methodology shall be established to identify, analyze, evaluate and treat cyber risks.
controls.full_text: A documented risk management methodology shall be established to identify, analyze, evaluate and treat cyber risks.

controls.title: Conduct periodic risk assessments
controls.description: Information security risk assessments shall be performed at planned intervals and when significant changes occur.
controls.full_text: Information security risk assessments shall be performed at planned intervals and when significant changes occur.

controls.title: Maintain a risk register
controls.description: Identified risks, their owners, treatment plans and residual risk shall be recorded and tracked in a risk register.
controls.full_text: Identified risks, their owners, treatment plans and residual risk shall be recorded and tracked in a risk register.

controls.title: Define risk acceptance criteria
controls.description: The organization shall define and apply criteria for accepting risk and the levels of risk it is willing to tolerate.
controls.full_text: The organization shall define and apply criteria for accepting risk and the levels of risk it is willing to tolerate.

controls.title: Implement risk treatment plans
controls.description: Risk treatment options shall be selected, implemented and their effectiveness monitored.
controls.full_text: Risk treatment options shall be selected, implemented and their effectiveness monitored.

controls.title: Establish an access control policy
controls.description: An access control policy shall be established based on business and security requirements and the principle of least privilege.
controls.full_text: An access control policy shall be established based on business and security requirements and the principle of least privilege.

controls.title: Manage user provisioning and de-provisioning
controls.description: A formal process shall govern the registration, modification and removal of user access rights across the lifecycle.
controls.full_text: A formal process shall govern the registration, modification and removal of user access rights across the lifecycle.

controls.title: Enforce strong authentication
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication shall be enforced for privileged, remote and high-risk access.
controls.full_text: Multi-factor authentication shall be enforced for privileged, remote and high-risk access.

controls.title: Restrict privileged access
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted, approved and monitored.
controls.full_text: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted, approved and monitored.

controls.title: Review user access rights periodically
controls.description: User access rights shall be reviewed at planned intervals and adjusted following role changes or termination.
controls.full_text: User access rights shall be reviewed at planned intervals and adjusted following role changes or termination.

controls.title: Classify information assets
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to sensitivity, legal requirements and value to the organization.
controls.full_text: Information shall be classified according to sensitivity, legal requirements and value to the organization.

controls.title: Protect personal data
controls.description: Personal data shall be processed lawfully and protected in line with applicable privacy regulations.
controls.full_text: Personal data shall be processed lawfully and protected in line with applicable privacy regulations.

controls.title: Prevent data leakage
controls.description: Data loss prevention controls shall be implemented to detect and prevent unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive data.
controls.full_text: Data loss prevention controls shall be implemented to detect and prevent unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive data.

controls.title: Manage data retention and disposal
controls.description: Data shall be retained only as long as necessary and securely disposed of when no longer required.
controls.full_text: Data shall be retained only as long as necessary and securely disposed of when no longer required.

controls.title: Control removable media
controls.description: The use of removable media shall be controlled and sensitive data on such media protected.
controls.full_text: The use of removable media shall be controlled and sensitive data on such media protected.

controls.title: Establish a cryptographic policy
controls.description: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls shall be developed and implemented.
controls.full_text: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls shall be developed and implemented.

controls.title: Encrypt data at rest and in transit
controls.description: Sensitive information shall be encrypted at rest and in transit using approved algorithms.
controls.full_text: Sensitive information shall be encrypted at rest and in transit using approved algorithms.

controls.title: Manage cryptographic keys
controls.description: Cryptographic keys shall be securely generated, distributed, stored, rotated and destroyed throughout their lifecycle.
controls.full_text: Cryptographic keys shall be securely generated, distributed, stored, rotated and destroyed throughout their lifecycle.

controls.title: Protect cryptographic modules
controls.description: Cryptographic modules and hardware security modules shall be protected against tampering and unauthorized use.
controls.full_text: Cryptographic modules and hardware security modules shall be protected against tampering and unauthorized use.

controls.title: Manage digital certificates
controls.description: Digital certificates shall be issued, renewed and revoked through a controlled process to prevent expiry and misuse.
controls.full_text: Digital certificates shall be issued, renewed and revoked through a controlled process to prevent expiry and misuse.

controls.title: Segment networks
controls.description: Networks shall be segmented to isolate critical systems and limit lateral movement.
controls.full_text: Networks shall be segmented to isolate critical systems and limit lateral movement.

controls.title: Secure network perimeters
controls.description: Perimeter defenses including firewalls and gateways shall be deployed and maintained.
controls.full_text: Perimeter defenses including firewalls and gateways shall be deployed and maintained.

controls.title: Protect wireless networks
controls.description: Wireless access shall be secured, authenticated and segregated from sensitive environments.
controls.full_text: Wireless access shall be secured, authenticated and segregated from sensitive environments.

controls.title: Secure remote access
controls.description: Remote access connections shall be encrypted, authenticated and monitored.
controls.full_text: Remote access connections shall be encrypted, authenticated and monitored.

controls.title: Filter malicious traffic
controls.description: Mechanisms shall be deployed to detect and block malicious network traffic.
controls.full_text: Mechanisms shall be deployed to detect and block malicious network traffic.

controls.title: Apply a secure development lifecycle
controls.description: Security shall be integrated throughout the software development lifecycle.
controls.full_text: Security shall be integrated throughout the software development lifecycle.

controls.title: Perform application security testing
controls.description: Applications shall undergo security testing including static analysis, dynamic analysis and code review before release.
controls.full_text: Applications shall undergo security testing including static analysis, dynamic analysis and code review before release.

controls.title: Protect code repositories and pipelines
controls.description: Source code repositories and CI/CD pipelines shall be access-controlled and protected.
controls.full_text: Source code repositories and CI/CD pipelines shall be access-controlled and protected.

controls.title: Separate development, test and production
controls.description: Development, test and production environments shall be separated to reduce risk.
controls.full_text: Development, test and production environments shall be separated to reduce risk.

controls.title: Manage software dependencies
controls.description: Third-party and open-source components shall be inventoried and assessed for vulnerabilities.
controls.full_text: Third-party and open-source components shall be inventoried and assessed for vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Maintain an asset inventory
controls.description: An accurate and current inventory of information and technology assets shall be maintained.
controls.full_text: An accurate and current inventory of information and technology assets shall be maintained.

controls.title: Assign asset ownership
controls.description: Each asset shall have an assigned owner responsible for its protection.
controls.full_text: Each asset shall have an assigned owner responsible for its protection.

controls.title: Establish secure baseline configurations
controls.description: Secure baseline configurations shall be defined and enforced for systems and devices.
controls.full_text: Secure baseline configurations shall be defined and enforced for systems and devices.

controls.title: Control changes to systems
controls.description: Changes to systems and applications shall follow a documented change management process.
controls.full_text: Changes to systems and applications shall follow a documented change management process.

controls.title: Manage capacity and decommissioning
controls.description: System capacity shall be monitored and assets securely decommissioned at end of life.
controls.full_text: System capacity shall be monitored and assets securely decommissioned at end of life.

controls.title: Perform vulnerability scanning
controls.description: Systems shall be scanned for vulnerabilities at planned intervals and findings remediated by severity.
controls.full_text: Systems shall be scanned for vulnerabilities at planned intervals and findings remediated by severity.

controls.title: Manage security patches
controls.description: Security patches shall be evaluated, tested and applied within defined timeframes.
controls.full_text: Security patches shall be evaluated, tested and applied within defined timeframes.

controls.title: Deploy anti-malware protection
controls.description: Anti-malware controls shall be deployed, maintained and monitored across endpoints and servers.
controls.full_text: Anti-malware controls shall be deployed, maintained and monitored across endpoints and servers.

controls.title: Conduct penetration testing
controls.description: Penetration tests shall be conducted periodically against critical systems.
controls.full_text: Penetration tests shall be conducted periodically against critical systems.

controls.title: Consume threat intelligence
controls.description: Relevant threat intelligence shall be collected and used to inform defensive measures.
controls.full_text: Relevant threat intelligence shall be collected and used to inform defensive measures.

controls.title: Establish a logging policy
controls.description: A logging and monitoring policy shall define what events are captured, retained and reviewed.
controls.full_text: A logging and monitoring policy shall define what events are captured, retained and reviewed.

controls.title: Generate and protect audit logs
controls.description: Audit logs shall be generated for security-relevant events and protected from tampering.
controls.full_text: Audit logs shall be generated for security-relevant events and protected from tampering.

controls.title: Monitor for security events
controls.description: Security events shall be continuously monitored and correlated to detect anomalies.
controls.full_text: Security events shall be continuously monitored and correlated to detect anomalies.

controls.title: Synchronize system clocks
controls.description: System clocks shall be synchronized to an authoritative time source.
controls.full_text: System clocks shall be synchronized to an authoritative time source.

controls.title: Review logs and alerts
controls.description: Logs and alerts shall be reviewed regularly and escalated according to defined procedures.
controls.full_text: Logs and alerts shall be reviewed regularly and escalated according to defined procedures.

controls.title: Establish an incident response plan
controls.description: An incident response plan shall define roles, procedures and communication for handling incidents.
controls.full_text: An incident response plan shall define roles, procedures and communication for handling incidents.

controls.title: Detect and report incidents
controls.description: Mechanisms and channels shall enable timely detection and reporting of security incidents.
controls.full_text: Mechanisms and channels shall enable timely detection and reporting of security incidents.

controls.title: Contain and eradicate incidents
controls.description: Procedures shall enable containment, eradication and recovery from security incidents.
controls.full_text: Procedures shall enable containment, eradication and recovery from security incidents.

controls.title: Preserve forensic evidence
controls.description: Digital evidence shall be collected and preserved in a forensically sound manner.
controls.full_text: Digital evidence shall be collected and preserved in a forensically sound manner.

controls.title: Conduct post-incident reviews
controls.description: Lessons learned from incidents shall be captured and used to improve controls.
controls.full_text: Lessons learned from incidents shall be captured and used to improve controls.

controls.title: Establish business continuity plans
controls.description: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans shall be developed and maintained.
controls.full_text: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans shall be developed and maintained.

controls.title: Perform data backups
controls.description: Backups of critical data and systems shall be performed, protected and periodically tested.
controls.full_text: Backups of critical data and systems shall be performed, protected and periodically tested.

controls.title: Test continuity arrangements
controls.description: Continuity and recovery plans shall be tested at planned intervals.
controls.full_text: Continuity and recovery plans shall be tested at planned intervals.

controls.title: Define recovery objectives
controls.description: Recovery time and recovery point objectives shall be defined for critical services.
controls.full_text: Recovery time and recovery point objectives shall be defined for critical services.

controls.title: Ensure redundancy of critical systems
controls.description: Critical systems shall have redundancy and failover arrangements to maintain availability.
controls.full_text: Critical systems shall have redundancy and failover arrangements to maintain availability.

controls.title: Assess third-party security risk
controls.description: Security risks of suppliers and service providers shall be assessed before engagement and periodically thereafter.
controls.full_text: Security risks of suppliers and service providers shall be assessed before engagement and periodically thereafter.

controls.title: Include security in contracts
controls.description: Security and confidentiality requirements shall be included in third-party agreements.
controls.full_text: Security and confidentiality requirements shall be included in third-party agreements.

controls.title: Monitor third-party performance
controls.description: Third-party security performance and compliance shall be monitored throughout the relationship.
controls.full_text: Third-party security performance and compliance shall be monitored throughout the relationship.

controls.title: Manage cloud service risk
controls.description: Risks associated with cloud services shall be assessed and appropriate controls applied.
controls.full_text: Risks associated with cloud services shall be assessed and appropriate controls applied.

controls.title: Manage supplier offboarding
controls.description: Access and data shall be securely retrieved or destroyed when a supplier relationship ends.
controls.full_text: Access and data shall be securely retrieved or destroyed when a supplier relationship ends.

controls.title: Screen personnel
controls.description: Background verification shall be performed for personnel commensurate with role sensitivity.
controls.full_text: Background verification shall be performed for personnel commensurate with role sensitivity.

controls.title: Deliver security awareness training
controls.description: All personnel shall receive periodic security awareness and role-based training.
controls.full_text: All personnel shall receive periodic security awareness and role-based training.

controls.title: Manage acceptable use
controls.description: An acceptable use policy for information assets shall be established and acknowledged.
controls.full_text: An acceptable use policy for information assets shall be established and acknowledged.

controls.title: Handle disciplinary process
controls.description: A formal disciplinary process shall address security policy violations.
controls.full_text: A formal disciplinary process shall address security policy violations.

controls.title: Manage termination responsibilities
controls.description: Security responsibilities that remain valid after termination shall be defined and enforced.
controls.full_text: Security responsibilities that remain valid after termination shall be defined and enforced.

controls.title: Secure physical perimeters
controls.description: Physical security perimeters shall protect areas containing information assets.
controls.full_text: Physical security perimeters shall protect areas containing information assets.

controls.title: Control physical entry
controls.description: Physical entry controls shall ensure only authorized personnel access secure areas.
controls.full_text: Physical entry controls shall ensure only authorized personnel access secure areas.

controls.title: Protect against environmental threats
controls.description: Protection shall be implemented against fire, flood, power loss and other environmental threats.
controls.full_text: Protection shall be implemented against fire, flood, power loss and other environmental threats.

controls.title: Secure equipment
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce risks from environmental threats and unauthorized access.
controls.full_text: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce risks from environmental threats and unauthorized access.

controls.title: Implement clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: A clear desk and clear screen practice shall be enforced to protect sensitive information.
controls.full_text: A clear desk and clear screen practice shall be enforced to protect sensitive information.
